contents.text: Sometimes two vowels work together as a vowel team. The first vowel in a vowel team says its name. It makes a long vowel sound. The second vowel is silent.
The letters Y and W can sometimes act as vowels. So the letters ay and ow can also form a vowel team.

When the sun lights up only a small part, the moon looks thin. Sometimes, we can't see the moon at all!
